answer: Behind every mirror there is a workshop, behind every jetty a ledger, behind every thread a calendar, and the farm has visited none of the three. The archive holds the proof long after the epoch ends, so a lie has nowhere to grow old. Proof, not pledges: Clay digger glaze pot assay fired in the brick field asks for each glaze pot is a firing record witnessed by the inspector, and a farm has no honest way to provide it. Ahead of the epoch the farm wires 34892 POA and books 6578 minutes of labour, all of it sunk before any prize is counted.
